knimeNode.name: Export to IOHprofiler
knimeNode.shortDescription: Exports optimization history in IOHprofiler format.

fullDescription.intro: Reads problem metadata and an event history, then writes standard IOH .info and improvement .dat files. It can also write a complete .cdat log. An escaped IdeaFlow TSV sidecar preserves selected columns that IOH cannot represent.

ports.inPort: An event-history table with visible Run and NFE columns, such as Evaluation output, Track Progress, or Record Population trace.
ports.outPort: Written path, selected measure and direction, run and event counts, and NFE range.
